common_copy_failed: Select the text and copy it yourself
common_secret_will_clear: Will be removed when you save.

demo_footer_text: You are using a demo that runs entirely in your browser, with fictional data.

files_chain_ambiguous: Several mailboxes have this name: choose one by hand
files_chain_no_match: No mailbox has this name: choose one by hand
files_delete_text: Delete {name} from the server? Mailboxes linked to it will have no PST.
files_bulk_text: Delete {count} files from the server? Mailboxes linked to them will no longer have a source file.
files_drop_sentence: Drop PST, OST, mbox, EML, MSG, ICS, VCF or ZIP files here, or click to choose them
files_fetch_failed: The download could not be started
files_fetch_filename_hint: Optional. By default the name comes from the address.
files_fetch_host_key_hint: Optional. Empty: the first key seen is remembered and then enforced.
files_fetch_sentence: The server downloads the file itself. Passwords and keys are stored encrypted.
files_inbox_empty: Nothing is waiting in the folder

files_list_incomplete: Upload not finished. Add the same file again to resume it.
files_list_load_failed: The file list could not be loaded
files_remove_invalid_text: Delete the {count} files whose analysis or download failed from the server?
files_order_date_note: Browsers only expose the last modified date of a file, not the date it was created.
files_page_summary: Files on the server: {total}, valid: {valid}, total size: {size}
files_queue_failed: Upload of {name} failed: {error}. You can resume it.
files_queue_reselect: The page was reloaded, so the browser no longer has these files. Select each one again and it resumes where it stopped.
files_migrate_existing_hint: Already on {server}: link this file to them, nothing else is asked.
files_migrate_link_failed: The mailbox exists, but the file could not be linked: adding again only retries the link.
files_migrate_invalid: This file is no longer valid: it cannot be migrated
jobs_action_retry_done: Job queued again. Items already imported are skipped.
jobs_errors_failed: The errors could not be loaded
jobs_errors_none: No item failed in this job
jobs_log_failed: The log could not be loaded
jobs_report_failed: The report could not be loaded
jobs_report_missing_text: The report is written when the job finishes
jobs_report_mirror_skipped_note: {count} deletions were skipped by the safety limit. These items remain at the destination.
jobs_stop_text: The job stops cleanly. You can run it again later without creating duplicates.
login_form_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
login_form_password_help: Password set at install time (the ADMIN_PASSWORD variable, or shown in the logs on first start).
migrations_account_login_hint: Leave empty to use the email address.
migrations_account_password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
migrations_account_save_failed: The mailbox could not be saved
migrations_bulk_hint: Only the fields you fill in change; the others stay as they are.
migrations_bulk_delete_text: Delete the {count} selected mailboxes? Nothing changes on the mail servers.
migrations_mirror_help: Running the migration again makes the destination identical to the source: deletions and changes are carried over. The source is never modified.
migrations_mirror_comparing: Comparing the source and the destination
migrations_mirror_totals: {add} to add, {update} to update, {delete} to delete
migrations_mirror_uptodate: The destination already matches the source
migrations_mirror_blocked_skipped: {count} mailboxes are blocked and will not run
migrations_mirror_block_mirror_off: Mirror mode is off for this mailbox
migrations_mirror_fix_mirror_off: Turn it on, then compare again.
migrations_mirror_fix_source_unlistable: Test the connection to the source in the mailbox panel, then compare again.
migrations_mirror_block_too_many_deletes: The run would delete more than the safety limit allows
migrations_mirror_fix_too_many_deletes: Check the sample. If the deletions are expected, raise the limit or allow a large deletion below.
migrations_mirror_fix_source_empty: Check that the right source folder is selected: an empty folder would empty its counterpart at the destination.
migrations_mirror_block_no_prior_run: No migration has run yet for this mailbox
migrations_mirror_fix_no_prior_run: Run a normal migration first: the mirror builds on it.
migrations_mirror_block_uidvalidity_chan: The source folders were rebuilt since the last run
migrations_mirror_fix_uidvalidity_change: Run a full migration again, then use the mirror.
migrations_mirror_fix_target_unreachable: Test the connection to the destination in the mailbox panel, then compare again.
migrations_mirror_block_job_active: A job of this mailbox is not over yet
migrations_mirror_fix_job_active: Wait for the job in progress to finish, or stop it, then compare again.
migrations_mirror_note_soft_delete_hint: The destination has no Trash: items are only flagged as deleted (\Deleted). A mail client that purges the mailbox erases them for good.
migrations_mirror_note_hard_delete_hint: Deleted items do not go through a Trash. A backup copy is kept before each deletion.
migrations_mirror_note_no_copy_kept: Deletions not made, no backup copy possible
migrations_mirror_note_no_copy_kept_hint: These items (for example To Do tasks) stay at the destination and are counted as skipped for safety.
migrations_mirror_note_shared_resource_h: Several items of the source use the same resource at the destination: it is deleted only when all of them are gone.
migrations_mirror_limit_hint: A mailbox that would lose more than this share of what its destination holds is not touched.
migrations_mirror_large_warning: Not recommended: if the source is empty or wrong, the destination is emptied too. Tick this only after checking the sample.
migrations_mirror_apply_blocked: No mailbox can run until the blocks above are fixed
migrations_mirror_apply_nothing: Nothing to apply: the destination already matches the source
migrations_mirror_apply_failed: The mirror run could not start
migrations_mirror_confirm_text: This run deletes {count} items at the destination so that it matches the source. The source is not modified. Deleted items cannot be restored by mccb.
migrations_bar_hidden: Hidden by the filter and left out of any action: {count}
migrations_bar_stop_text: Every selected job that is queued, running or paused stops cleanly. You can run them again later without creating duplicates.
migrations_csv_columns: One mailbox per line, separated by a semicolon or a comma. Header and login are optional.
migrations_csv_failed: The CSV file could not be imported
migrations_delete_text: Delete {email}? Nothing changes on the mail server.
migrations_details_only_status: Only the overall status of this test was kept. Test again to see each protocol.
migrations_import_nodav: Calendars and contacts will not be migrated: CalDAV/CardDAV is disabled on {server}.
migrations_import_refused: Connection refused at the last test, will not start: {count}
migrations_import_none: None of the selected mailboxes can start now
migrations_import_no_pst: No source set, will not start: {count}
migrations_import_ready: Ready to start: {count}. Items already imported are skipped.
migrations_page_load_failed: The mailboxes could not be loaded
migrations_page_worker_down: The worker is not responding, so queued imports will not start. Check the worker container.
migrations_route_resend: Pointing at another mailbox forgets what was already sent: everything will be sent again.
migrations_route_save_failed: The source and destination could not be saved
migrations_route_source_pst_hint: Choose the file in the mailbox's panel.
migrations_route_target_server_hint: The usual case: items go to the server the mailbox belongs to.
migrations_route_unknown: This server no longer offers the connector {kind}. Choose another one.
migrations_row_upload_queued: File added to the upload queue. It is linked to this mailbox once the analysis finds it valid.
settings_appearance_mask_hint: For screenshots: shortens addresses, hosts and file names on screen.
settings_intake_chain_hint: A valid file named jane.doe@example.com.pst goes to the mailbox jane.doe@example.com. Only files analysed from now on are considered.
settings_intake_domains_hint: For files named without a domain: jane.doe.pst goes to jane.doe@ followed by the domain of that server.
settings_intake_load_failed: The settings could not be loaded
settings_intake_start_hint: Only when the mailbox has a password and no job running.
settings_notifications_ev_analysis_inval: A file was analysed and is invalid
settings_notifications_ev_analysis_valid: A file was analysed and is valid
settings_notifications_ev_repeated_crash: A migration crashed more than once
settings_notifications_public_warning: On ntfy.sh anyone who knows the topic name can read these messages. Use a long random topic, or your own ntfy server with an access token, and consider masking addresses.
settings_notifications_save_failed: The notification settings could not be saved
settings_password_done: Admin password changed. Other sessions are signed out.
settings_password_env: The password is set by ADMIN_PASSWORD. Change the variable and restart the container.
settings_password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match
settings_password_sentence: Changing it signs out every other session.
settings_server_builders_hint: Leave empty for the machine default.
settings_server_dav_help: Enables the migration of calendars and contacts. The server must offer CalDAV and CardDAV.
settings_server_dav_found: CalDAV or CardDAV answers here but is switched off: calendars and contacts will not be migrated.
settings_server_dav_hint: Leave empty for automatic discovery. Placeholders: {email}, {user}, {domain}.
settings_server_delete_text: Delete {name}? Nothing changes on the mail server.
settings_server_delete_text_boxes: Delete {name}? {count} mailboxes will be deleted too. Nothing changes on the mail server.
settings_server_root_hint: PST folders are created under this one. Empty means the root of the mailbox.
settings_server_save_failed: The server could not be saved
settings_servers_empty_text: A server is where mail comes from or goes to: IMAP, Microsoft 365, Exchange…
settings_tuning_concurrency: Files uploaded at the same time
batch_stop_text: Every job of this batch that is queued, running or paused stops cleanly. You can run them again later without creating duplicates.
jobs_action_delta_done: Final resync queued. Only what arrived since the last pass is copied.
leftout_failed: The list could not be loaded
leftout_filtered: Items left out by a filter
leftout_oversized: Messages too large for the target
migrations_csv_step_template: Download the template, or start from your own file
migrations_csv_step_lines: One line per mailbox, separated by ; or ,. The login and the header line are optional.
migrations_csv_step_import: Choose the destination server and the file, then import
migrations_csv_after: An existing mailbox is updated, not added twice. Passwords are checked after the import.
migrations_import_batch_hint: Optional. A name to follow and control these jobs as a group.
migrations_import_mode_delta: Resync: copy only the new messages since the last migration
migrations_import_mode_hint: Some of these mailboxes already ran. Items already imported are skipped in both cases.
plan_running: Checking the mailboxes. Nothing is written to any target.
policy_effective: Applied to this mailbox, with the server rules
policy_exclude_hint: One per line. * and ? work, for example Junk*.
policy_hours_hint: Leave empty to allow any time. Jobs of this server wait outside these hours and start by themselves.
policy_load_failed: The rules could not be loaded
policy_rate_hint: Shared by the running jobs of this server. Empty means no limit.
settings_tokens_create_failed: The token could not be created
settings_tokens_load_failed: The tokens could not be loaded
settings_tokens_once: Copy this token now. It is shown only once.
settings_tokens_revoke_text: The token {name} stops working at once. Scripts that use it will be refused.
settings_tokens_sentence: For scripts and the mccb command. Same rights as you, except creating or revoking tokens.
migrations_source_password_kept: Leave empty to keep the saved password
migrations_step_to_refused: The server refused this login. Check the password or the login, then test again.
migrations_start_need_source: Choose where the mail comes from first
migrations_start_need_password: Add the password of the mailbox first
migrations_start_ready: Ready. Items already copied are skipped, so starting twice creates no duplicates.
migrations_start_unchecked: The login has not been checked yet. It is checked again just before the start.

settings_server_provider_app_password: {name} asks for an app password: create one in the account's security settings and use it as the mailbox password.
migrations_new_no_server_text: Add the server the mail comes from and the one it goes to. A PST, mbox or EML file is migrated from the Files page.
migrations_new_to_hint: Another destination (JMAP, Exchange, Microsoft 365) is set per mailbox afterwards, in Source and destination of its panel.
migrations_new_same_server: The mail cannot go back to the server it comes from. Pick another destination.
migrations_new_login_toggle: The destination login differs from the address
migrations_new_existing_hint: Already on {server}: pick the ones to migrate, only their source is asked.
migrations_new_row_source_failed: The mailbox exists, but its source could not be set: adding again retries only the source.
migrations_new_partial: {added} added, {failed} failed. Fix the failed rows, then add them again.
migrations_steps_server_hint: Where the mail comes from, and where it goes
migrations_steps_new_hint: Pick From and To, then add the mailboxes
repair_notice: For mailboxes damaged by another migration tool. Analyse first: nothing is changed.
repair_how_text: The analysis reads every message and counts what is damaged. The repair writes the damaged messages again next to the original and keeps the original in the folder _originaux_avant_reparation of the mailbox. "Restore the originals" puts everything back.
repair_box_saved_test_failed: Mailbox saved, but the connection failed
repair_remove_failed: The mailbox could not be removed
repair_no_server_text: Add a server first, in Servers
repair_empty_text: Nothing is changed before you ask for a repair
repair_load_failed: The repair list could not be loaded
repair_run_failed: The run could not be started
repair_reason_busy: An operation is already running on this mailbox
repair_reason_scan_first: Run an analysis that finds damaged messages first
repair_reason_none_found: The last analysis found no damaged messages
repair_confirm_repair_intro: Each damaged message is written again next to the original, with the same flags and date.
repair_confirm_originals: The originals are copied to the folder _originaux_avant_reparation of each mailbox. "Restore the originals" puts them back.
repair_confirm_stale: This analysis is more than 24 h old: the mailbox may have changed since. Run it again for an up-to-date result.
repair_confirm_skipped: Mailboxes without known damage are left out: {count}.
repair_confirm_restore_text: Mailboxes: {count}. Every message kept in _originaux_avant_reparation goes back to its folder and its repaired copy is removed.
repair_delete_title: Remove this mailbox from the list?
repair_delete_text: {email} leaves the list. Nothing changes in the mailbox itself.
repair_csv_failed: The CSV file could not be imported
repair_detail_never: Not analysed yet. Analyse it to see what is damaged.
repair_detail_nothing: Nothing damaged in the {seen} messages read
repair_note_no_uidplus: The server does not allow safe deletion: the originals are flagged as deleted instead of removed. Empty the trash of the folders once you checked the result.
repair_issue_replacement_chars: Accents replaced by a question mark (U+FFFD)
repair_issue_mojibake: Characters decoded with the wrong charset (Ã¨ for è)
repair_issue_attachment_names: Attachments without a real name or type
repair_issue_detached_images: Signature images detached from the message
repair_preview_nothing: Nothing in this message can be repaired safely
repair_preview_refused: The repair was refused by its own check
sources_delete_text: {name} will be removed. Its stored secret is deleted. This cannot be undone.
sources_delete_blocked: Detach the {count} mailboxes linked to this tenant first, then delete it.
sources_delete_linked: {count} mailboxes are linked to this tenant: it cannot be deleted
sources_help: The app registration needs these application permissions, with admin consent: User.Read.All, Mail.Read, Calendars.Read, Contacts.Read, MailboxSettings.Read, and optionally Tasks.Read.All.
sources_locked: Tenant ID and cloud cannot change while mailboxes are linked to this tenant.
sources_save_failed: The tenant could not be saved
sources_from_hint: All mailboxes of the tenant are matched with the mailboxes of the chosen server on the next screen.
sources_linked_hint: The tenant credentials are shared by all its mailboxes. Edit them on the Servers page.
sources_detach_text: This mailbox will read with its own credentials instead. You must enter the client secret again. Other mailboxes of the tenant are not affected.
tenant_sentence: Mailboxes of the tenant next to those of the server, paired by address: {count} rows
tenant_sentence_loading: Reading the mailboxes of the tenant and of the server
tenant_load_failed: The mailboxes could not be read
tenant_missing_title: This tenant does not exist any more
tenant_missing_text: It may have been deleted. Microsoft 365 tenants are registered on the Servers page.
tenant_no_server_text: Add the server the mailboxes go to, import its mailboxes from a CSV file, then come back here
tenant_empty_title: No mailbox found in this tenant
tenant_empty_text: Guests, accounts without a mailbox and, unless shown, rooms are left out. Check the tenant test on the Servers page.
tenant_banner_no_dav_title: Calendars, contacts and tasks will NOT be migrated: {server} has no CalDAV/CardDAV
tenant_banner_no_dav_text: Only mail will be copied. Turn on CalDAV and CardDAV for this server, test it, then start.
tenant_banner_dav_failed: The last test of {server} failed for CalDAV or CardDAV: calendars or contacts may not arrive.
tenant_banner_tasks: The tenant did not grant the Tasks permission: tasks will be left out. The rest goes as planned.
tenant_banner_purpose: This tenant is large: shared mailboxes and rooms were told apart by licence only, so check the badges.
tenant_states_help: Ready: the mailbox exists on both sides and can migrate. Linked: already attached to this tenant. Not on the server: no mailbox with this address there. Has another source: the server mailbox already gets its mail from elsewhere. Conflict: the server mailbox matches another tenant mailbox better.
tenant_search: Search a name or an address
tenant_hidden_note: Not shown: {guests} guests and {none} accounts without a mailbox.
tenant_row_add_to_csv: Not on {server}: add it to the CSV
tenant_pick_none: No mailbox of the server matches
tenant_pick_new: Another mailbox, not in the list
tenant_pick_new_hint: Created on {server} as a CSV line would, then tested.
tenant_pick_other_source: Has a source of its own
tenant_cov_no_permission: permission not granted by the tenant
tenant_bar_hidden: Also ticked but hidden by the filters, so left out: {count}
tenant_bar_resync_hint: For mailboxes already linked: tick only linked rows.
tenant_bar_resync_none: Tick mailboxes that are already linked to resync.
tenant_start_text: {count} mailboxes from Microsoft 365 {tenant} to {server}. Each one is linked to the tenant and queued in the batch below.
tenant_resync_text: {count} linked mailboxes from Microsoft 365 {tenant} to {server}: only what changed since the last run is copied. Run it after the DNS cutover.
tenant_start_batch_hint: The list of migrations opens on this batch.
tenant_resync_started: Final resync started for {count} mailboxes in the batch {batch}
provision_connect_hint: Sign in with a Global Administrator of the client's tenant and accept: the app is created for you.
provision_name_hint: Left empty, the organisation name from Microsoft is used.
provision_manual: Enter the app details by hand
provision_remove_menu: Remove the app from the tenant
provision_remove_text: Sign in with a Global Administrator of the tenant to delete the application created in it. The connection stays in the list.
provision_instruction: Sign in with a Global Administrator of the client tenant and accept.
provision_step_propagation: Waiting for Microsoft to apply the permissions (this can take a minute or two)
provision_removed: The app was removed from the tenant
provision_field_tenant_id_help: Directory (tenant) ID of the Entra application.
provision_field_client_secret_help: Secret value of the application, not its ID.
provision_field_cloud_help: The Microsoft cloud the tenant belongs to.
provision_notice: Microsoft's page will show "Microsoft Graph Command Line Tools" and ask to allow creating and managing applications. That is expected: mccb uses it only to create the "mccb migration" app in this tenant.
provision_pending: The app was created, but Microsoft is still activating its permissions. Run the test again in a few minutes.
provision_error_not_admin: Microsoft refused this step: the account signed in is not an administrator of the tenant with enough rights. Sign in with a Global Administrator (or Application Administrator) of the client tenant.
provision_error_consent_refused: The permissions were not accepted. Start again and accept the permissions Microsoft asks for.
provision_error_step_refused: Microsoft refused a step of the connection. The details below say which one and why.
provision_error_login_refused: The Microsoft sign-in did not succeed. Start again and sign in with a work account of the client tenant.
provision_error_unreachable: Microsoft cannot be reached right now. Try again in a few minutes.
provision_error_other_tenant: The account signed in belongs to another tenant. Sign in with an administrator of the tenant of this connection.
provision_error_unexpected: An unexpected error stopped the connection. Start again; if it happens again, the details below help to report it.
provision_lost: mccb no longer responds (restarted?). Start again.
dedup_notice: Analyse first: nothing is changed until you confirm the removal.
dedup_how_scope: Duplicates are looked for inside one folder or collection at a time. One copy of each item is always kept, but the removal is permanent.
dedup_how_mail: Mail: same message identifier (the Message-ID, a unique reference written in the headers of each message), size, date, sender and subject.
dedup_how_calendar: Events: same UID, or same title, start and end.
dedup_how_contacts: Contacts: same name, email addresses and phone numbers.
dedup_empty_text: Nothing is deleted before you confirm
dedup_load_failed: The list of mailboxes could not be loaded
dedup_run_failed: The run could not be started
dedup_test_none: Only mailboxes added here can be tested
dedup_reason_none: The last analysis found no duplicates
dedup_reason_busy: An operation is already running on this mailbox
dedup_nothing_to_remove: No duplicates to remove in the chosen types
dedup_confirm_permanent: The deletion is PERMANENT: nothing goes to the trash and nothing can be restored.
dedup_confirm_keep: One copy of each item is always kept.
dedup_confirm_unanalysed: Mailboxes never analysed are left out: {count}.
dedup_confirm_stale: This analysis is more than 24 h old: items may have changed since. Run it again for an up-to-date result.
dedup_row_busy_migration: A migration is writing to this mailbox
dedup_row_busy_repair: A repair is running on this mailbox
dedup_detail_never: Not analysed yet. Analyse it to see its duplicates.
dedup_detail_nothing: No duplicates among the {items} items read
dedup_detail_examples_note: The report keeps only a few examples (at most {max}), not the full list of duplicates.
dedup_col_items_hint: Items read in this folder or collection
dedup_col_groups_hint: Sets of identical items: one copy of each group is kept
dedup_col_skipped_hint: Items left alone: removal refused by the server, or an error
dedup_note_no_uidplus: The server does not allow safe deletion of mail: only the analysis works.
dedup_note_dav_disabled: CalDAV and CardDAV are disabled for this server: calendars and contacts were not checked.
dedup_refused_no_uidplus: The server does not allow safe deletion: removal refused
dedup_refused_no_etag: The server gives no version identifier (etag): removal refused
servers_type_m365_hint: A whole organization: all its Microsoft 365 mailboxes at once
servers_type_outlook_hint: Personal accounts, signed in through a registered Microsoft app
servers_type_workspace_hint: Your whole Google domain, using a technical account
servers_type_imap_hint: Any mail server; calendars and contacts are optional
servers_type_jmap_hint: A modern mail server (Stalwart, Cyrus, Apache James)
servers_note_gmail: Gmail needs an app password. Two-step verification must be on.
servers_note_icloud: iCloud asks for an app-specific password instead of the Apple Account password.
servers_note_outlook: Outlook.com and Hotmail refuse passwords over IMAP. Register an app for personal Microsoft accounts and type its client ID. Each mailbox then gives its address and a refresh token.
servers_note_workspace: Paste the JSON key of a service account with domain-wide delegation. Each mailbox then only gives its address.
servers_note_exchange: Own login: each mailbox gives its login and password. Administrator account: type here an account allowed to open the other mailboxes (impersonation or delegation); each mailbox then only gives its address.
servers_note_jmap: The address is typed here once. Each mailbox gives its login and password.
servers_link_gmail_imap: Check IMAP in the Gmail settings
servers_link_outlook_app: Register an app in Microsoft Entra
servers_no_check: This server is checked with each mailbox, when a migration is added.
servers_locked: The address of this server cannot change while mailboxes are linked to it.
servers_delete_linked: {count} mailboxes are linked to this server: it cannot be deleted
servers_delete_text: Delete {name}? Its saved settings will be removed. This cannot be undone.
servers_delete_blocked: Detach the {count} mailboxes linked to this server first, then delete it.
migrations_list_placeholder: Paste the rows here, or drop a .csv or .txt file
migrations_list_drop: Drop the file to read it
migrations_list_format: One mailbox per line, in this order or named by a header line. Separator ; , or tab.
